Discipline Priest Healing Stat Priority — 12.1

1.

Discipline Priest Stat Priority

All of our secondary stats are very close in value. Due to the scaling of Intellect on gear as well as the closeness of the secondary stat values, targeting the highest item level possible is the recommended play in terms of gearing.

1.1.

Voidweaver Stat Priority

The stat priority is as follows when deciding between equal item level gear.

Haste (until 1800 rating)
Mastery
Critical Strike
Versatility
1.2.

Oracle Stat Priority

The stat priority is as follows when deciding between equal item level gear.

Haste
Mastery
Critical Strike
Versatility

For Oracle, all our stats are fairly close in value, so you should avoid stacking any single stat past any diminishing returns breakpoint.

Optimization
Simulations and Tools
While a generalized stat priority will assist new players, there really is no substitute for simming your character. Learn more with this guide!
